description: Scan git log, session chronicles, and results.tsv crash entries to automatically identify recurring friction patterns and propose new gaps. Closes the self-sustaining growth loop.
notes: v2 kept: chronicles+TSV only (no subprocess). fitness 4.65/5.0. v1 crashed: subprocess + open() outside toolbox.

description: Read a context bundle manifest JSON (see planning/context-bundles/) and concatenate the listed files into a single /tmp/context_bundle.md with headers per file. Enables structured Copilot CLI context injection.
notes: Highest priority: enables context bundling for ALL future Copilot generation calls. Without this, every prompt is ad-hoc. Target < 70 lines.

description: After each iteration, append a structured entry to planning/friction_log.md: what was the friction, what was the root cause, what micro-fix is proposed. Reads results.tsv last row for context.
notes: Enables compounding improvement. Every iteration leaves the loop better. Target < 60 lines.

description: Scan results.tsv for malformed rows (wrong column count, missing fields, non-numeric fitness scores) and either repair or flag them. Output a clean version.
notes: Session 1 produced a malformed row when sandbox ran the benchmark script. Target < 40 lines.

description: Time 3 operations (file scan, docstring extract, JSON write) and append ONE structured row to results.tsv. Accept --target-dir argument.
notes: v1 DISCARD: 173 lines (over limit) + fitness_depth=0.1 (under threshold). Retry with bundled context, max 4 requirements, target < 70 lines.
retry_note: Use meta-bundle-builder output as Copilot context. Spec: 4 requirements max. Must have nested error handling to score depth.

description: Scan SKILL.md files under a given directory for compliance: YAML frontmatter, required fields, references/ dir, evals/results.tsv. Output structured JSON report.
notes: Use skill-audit context bundle. Target < 80 lines.

description: Estimate token count for files/directories using word-count heuristic (words * 1.3). Accept list of paths, output per-file and total estimate.
notes: Needed to safely size context bundles before feeding to Copilot. Target < 50 lines.

description: Scan a directory of Python files and extract metadata: name, lines, first_docstring_line, has_type_hints, has_test_block. Output JSON.
